scope: UK-facing Nigerian and West African food catalogue
methodology: Published WAFCT per-100 g profiles are used directly for simple foods. Mixed dishes are transparent NutriRoot baseline recipes calculated from WAFCT ingredients and a stated final cooked yield.

priority.reason: Census 2021 identifies Nigerian and Ghanaian as the two largest specified West African backgrounds in England and Wales.

extended_uk_communities.reason: Additional established West African communities and shared food traditions in the UK.

regional.reason: Broader geographic West African coverage, including foods shared across borders.

sources.title: FAO/INFOODS Food Composition Table for Western Africa (2019)
sources.licence: FAO copyright statement permits attributed private study, research, teaching and non-commercial use. Translation, adaptation, resale and other commercial rights must be requested from FAO.
sources.note: Primary nutrient source. Values are per 100 g edible portion. See DATA_LICENSE.md before distributing or commercially using this catalogue.

sources.title: McCance and Widdowson's Composition of Foods Integrated Dataset 2021
sources.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated
sources.note: Registered UK-market reference for future validation; V0.4 nutrient rows are generated from WAFCT.

sources.title: Census 2021: ethnic group and country of birth, England and Wales
sources.note: Used to prioritise Nigerian and Ghanaian coverage; it is not a nutrition source.
